text:
Tiny crystals in the air,
Spread from the sea far and wide.
Soothes wounds of skin and soul,
Healing all things it holds.
Refreshing taste on lips,
In sweat and tears, on its bliss.
Salt sea, salt sky, salt life's rhyme,
Everlasting in time.
prompt: Write a short poem about salt.
system: Write only the poem. No title, no commentary, no explanation. Keep it under 12 short lines.
